interpretation: These comparisons assess numerical stability on the declared finite window, not a continuum proof. A/B scores use frozen coarse-trained fits; this is not a new independent replication or a fine-grid-trained optimal model comparison. No Eulerian first-event location or exact onset target is tested.

original_matched_stretch_snapshot.limits: Partial original matrix. Nonsmooth periodic joins and off-central initial maxima retained. These global vorticity comparisons do not validate marker FTLE or the smooth-flow prediction pilot.
